pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.p1Desc: Customers message whichever employee they happen to know. The owner never sees it, messages slip through, and customers quietly move on.
pains.p2Title: Customer info lives in notebooks and heads
pains.p2Desc: What they like, what they bought, when they're due back — everyone remembers a fragment. When staff leave, your customer list leaves with them.
pains.p3Desc: The same questions, a dozen times a day. You're serving customers in person while glued to the phone.

features.title: iFan takes that off your plate

inbox.label: Unified inbox
inbox.title: Every customer message in one place
inbox.description: Zalo OA first, more channels on the roadmap. Your whole team works one shared inbox — nothing sits locked in someone's personal phone.
inbox.b1: Messages arrive in real time, visible to the whole team
inbox.b2: Assign an owner to every conversation — every customer has someone on it
inbox.b3: Internal notes right inside the conversation, invisible to the customer
inbox.b4: 48-hour Zalo OA reply-window reminders so you never miss your turn

crm.label: Customer CRM
crm.title: Remember every customer like your best employee does
crm.description: No manual data entry — customer profiles fill themselves from your conversations.
crm.b1: Profiles auto-capture names, phone numbers, and needs from chat
crm.b2: Accent-insensitive search — “nguyen thi hoa” still finds Ms. Hoa
crm.b3: Tiers (New · Regular · VIP · Dormant) so you nurture the right people

ai.label: AI assistant
ai.title: AI reads the conversation, your day gets lighter
ai.description: The assistant lives right inside your inbox — no separate tools, no technical skills required.
ai.b1: Summarizes long conversations in seconds — pick up any handover instantly
ai.b2: Extracts names, phone numbers, and needs into the customer profile
ai.b3: Suggests replies — tweak a few words and send

pricing.note: Planned launch pricing and limits — final at official launch. Zalo OA connection is rolling out gradually to early-access customers.

growth.name: Growth

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. iFan runs in your web browser on any computer or phone. Create an account and you're in — no IT team required.
faq.q2: Does iFan use personal Zalo or Zalo OA?
faq.a2: iFan uses official Zalo OA only, connected through Zalo’s official API — safe, policy-compliant, never touching personal Zalo accounts. During early access, OA connection is being rolled out gradually to each customer.
faq.a3: Each business gets a fully isolated workspace with regular backups. Your customer data belongs to you and is never shared.
faq.q4: What if I want to cancel?
faq.a4: Cancel anytime — no contracts, no lock-in. Stop using iFan and you stop paying.
faq.a5: Yes. The interface ships in Vietnamese and English — switch instantly in-app. More languages are on the roadmap.
